description: This source file defines an Entity Framework Core migration class 'InitialModel' that creates and drops database schema components such as tables, sequences, and constraints for an e-commerce application's database.

classes.name: InitialModel
classes.description: A Migration class for setting up the initial database schema for the e-commerce application.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the operations to apply the migration, creating tables, sequences, and foreign key constraints.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Defines the operations to revert the migration, dropping tables, sequences, and constraints.
